# package fxserver

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uafx/fxserver"
```

Package fxserver adds the information model of OPC UA FX (UAFX, OPC 10000-81 version 1.00.04) to a server.Server: the types of the UAFX Data, AutomationComponent (AC) and ConnectionManager (CM) namespaces, the Devices (DI) model of OPC 10000-100 they build on, the FxRoot object (Part 81 §12.2) and the NamespaceMetadata objects of the three UAFX namespaces (§14.1).

The model is the address space only. The Methods of the model (EstablishConnections, CloseConnections, Verify, VerifyAsset and the Methods of the ConnectionManager) have no implementation: the server answers a call with Bad\_MethodInvalid, as for any Method without a handler. A server becomes an AutomationComponent with the instances an application imports with ImportNodeSet.

	srv := server.New(opts...)
	ns, err := fxserver.AddModel(srv)
	...
	err = fxserver.ImportNodeSet(srv, myAutomationComponentNodeSet)

Import the model before the server starts.

## Variables

```go
var ErrModel = errors.New("fxserver: UAFX model")
```

ErrModel reports that the UAFX model cannot be added to the server.

## Functions

### func ImportNodeSet

```go
func ImportNodeSet(srv *server.Server, data []byte) error
```

ImportNodeSet imports the NodeSet2 document data into srv with the namespace indexes of the server: each namespace of the NamespaceUris of the document gets the index the server has for it, or a new namespace on the server (Part 6 §F.2). Use it for the instances of an AutomationComponent, which a NodeSet describes in a namespace of its own with references to the UAFX types.

## Types

### type Model

```go
type Model uint8
```

Model selects a part of the UAFX model for AddModel.

```go
const (
	// ModelAC is the AutomationComponent model (namespace
	// http://opcfoundation.org/UA/FX/AC/), with DI.
	ModelAC Model = 1 << iota
	// ModelCM is the ConnectionManager model (namespace
	// http://opcfoundation.org/UA/FX/CM/), with DI.
	ModelCM
)
```

### type Namespaces

```go
type Namespaces struct {
	DI   uint16 // http://opcfoundation.org/UA/DI/
	Data uint16 // http://opcfoundation.org/UA/FX/Data/
	AC   uint16 // http://opcfoundation.org/UA/FX/AC/
	CM   uint16 // http://opcfoundation.org/UA/FX/CM/
}
```

Namespaces are the namespace indexes of the UAFX model on a server. An index of 0 is a namespace the server does not have.

#### func AddModel

```go
func AddModel(srv *server.Server, models ...Model) (Namespaces, error)
```

AddModel imports the UAFX model into srv: the Data namespace, which a UAFX server must have, and the AC and CM models selected by models, both when models is empty (Part 81 §14.2: a UAFX server has at least one of them). DI is imported unless the server has the DI namespace already, for example from an application that imported it before. A UAFX namespace the server has already is an error.
